segments.text: SHANGHAI: Japanese rubber futures eased to their lowest level in nearly a month on Monday, pressured by a decline in oil prices, although losses were capped as weather-related disruptions affected tapping in key rubber-producing regions.

newsDocuments.headline: Gold rises as lower oil prices ease inflation fears

segments.text: NEW YORK: Gold prices rose on Monday, rebounding from the previous session’s over three-month low, as retreating oil prices tempered inflation concerns ahead of this week’s US Federal Reserve meeting. Spot gold rose 0.3 percent to USD4,007.
“There’s been a bit of a pullback in crude oil, which is helping gold, while some bargain-hunting is also coming in,” said Bob Haberkorn, senior market strategist at StoneX.

newsDocuments.headline: Govt increases diesel price by Rs2.16, petrol by Rs1.54 per litre

segments.text: Pakistan government increased on Monday the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2.16 per litre and petrol by Rs1.54 per litre.

According to a press release issued by the Petroleum Division, the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) revised the ex-depot prices of petroleum products under the federal government’s petroleum pricing mechanism.
The government on Friday increased the price of high-speed diesel by Rs1.91 per litre while keeping petrol price unchanged.
